title: Map Cleanup
description: Reset damaged or over-looted map areas so the world can regenerate cleanly

defaults.setAsDefault: Make this the panel's default Zomboid data folder so you don't have to re-enter it.

labels.chunkMap: Chunk map — select areas to clean up

warnings.header: Deleting chunks resets those areas — constructions, loot, and zombies will be lost. Stop the server first and keep backups enabled.

path.helpPrefix: Point at your Zomboid data folder, a
path.helpMiddle: folder, or a single save directory.
path.autoDetected: Auto-detected this folder. Save it as the default?
path.savedToServer: Saved to the active server config — the panel will use this path next time.

empty.selectSaveDescription: Choose a save from the panel to review chunk data.
empty.noSavesDescription: The panel could not list any saves with the current data path.
empty.installFolderHint: Looks like a server install folder — point at the user data folder instead.
empty.missingHint: Folder does not exist on this host
empty.howToFind: How to find your data folder
empty.multiplayerSuffix: subfolder once the server has been started at least once.
empty.singleSavePrefix: You can also point directly at a single save folder (e.g.
empty.noChunksDescription: Map folder may be empty or the path needs adjusting.

help.selectDescription: Click or drag to select. Hold Shift to deselect.
help.navigateDescription: Scroll to zoom, right-click to pan. Press 1/2 to switch tools.
help.deleteDescription: Rebuilds those areas on next visit. Press Delete or use the button.
help.shortcutsDescription: Esc clears selection. Backup stays enabled by default.

delete.label: Delete
delete.confirmDescription: This permanently removes {{count}} chunk files ({{size}}). When players revisit those areas, the game rebuilds them and removes any player-built structures or stored items there.
delete.backupDescription: Save a copy of the selected chunks before deleting them.
delete.noBackupDescription: You will not be able to recover these chunks after deletion.
delete.loadedVehicles: {{count}} vehicle(s) currently loaded in this area.
delete.unloadedVehicles: Unloaded vehicles still live in vehicles.db and respawn when a player revisits.
delete.removeVehiclesDescription: Deletes matching rows from vehicles.db so cars do not come back.
delete.safehouseWarning: Structures will be lost when chunks regenerate.

serverRunning.title: Server appears to be running
serverRunning.description: The panel detected processes that look like a Project Zomboid dedicated server. Deleting chunks while the server is live will corrupt the save when it writes back on shutdown.
serverRunning.noProcessInfo: No matched process info was returned, but the detector reported the server as running.
serverRunning.overrideTitle: Only override if you are sure
serverRunning.overrideDescription: If you stopped the server with a custom systemd unit / launcher we do not recognise, or one of the processes above is unrelated (e.g. a different Java app), you can force the delete. Otherwise, stop the server first.
